name: Turn a sales call into a checked proposal
why: Takes call notes to a checked proposal and a plan to signature, the same path as the client-proposal skill.

name: Prepare a vendor security questionnaire response
why: Answers a security questionnaire from evidence with an evidence index and open questions, matching the confirmed, partial or gap method here.

name: Win a deal against a named rival
why: Plans how to answer a known rival fairly, useful when setting win themes.

name: Capability pitch letter writer
why: Writes a capability letter where every line can be shown, for buyers who ask before a formal tender.

name: Hardest objections answer writer
why: Finds the toughest doubts about a bid and drafts fair answers with gaps shown, for Red team prep.

name: Prepare your first freelance project quote
why: Turns a project brief into a freelance quote with clear scope, price assumptions and contract risks to check.

name: Hourly rate calculator
why: Works out hourly, day and project prices from target pay and costs, so proposal options rest on the client's own numbers.

name: Value ladder planner
why: Lays out offers from a first step upward, a useful base for good, better and best packages.

name: Client scope decision review assistant
why: Compares change requests with the signed scope, which keeps the not-included list honest after the win.

name: Contract intake reviewer
why: Rates a contract's clauses and drafts questions before signing; a lawyer still checks, as this kit advises.

name: Monthly lost deal reviewer
why: Finds why deals are lost and revises the pitch, the same loop as the debrief-and-lessons prompt.

name: Quarterly client rate reviewer
why: Shows each client's real hourly rate, so the next proposal prices from evidence.
